test_framework: vitest 4 (`vitest run`). Tests live next to source as *.test.ts and under __tests__/ (including __tests__/integration/). crypto.randomUUID is available in test env.

contribution_requirements: Follow the APPROVED design verbatim where it specifies behavior. Keep the DB odds and payout columns (no drop migration). New API routes use withSecurity(...) + CACHE_CONTROL from lib/security/routeHelpers.ts and checkQueryParams for query inputs, mirroring app/api/tipsters/route.ts. Caching uses cached() + CACHE_TTL from lib/cache.ts. Each feature must leave the build green (all four verify commands).
key_patterns: Betslip win-rate aggregation convention (statuses are stored title-cased 'Won'/'Lost'; rate is over graded slips only) is in app/api/tipsters/route.ts and must be matched exactly. Paged reads past Supabase's 1000-row cap use fetchAllIn / fetchPagedParallel from lib/supabase/paged.ts. Admin reads use createAdminClient() from lib/supabase/admin.ts. The marketplace sport chips are SPORT_FILTERS = ['All','Football','Basketball','Tennis','Cricket','NFL','Formula 1','Esports','MMA','Boxing','Golf'] in app/(app)/marketplace/TipstersClient.tsx. The parlay leaderboard UI (rank medals, pulse skeleton) is app/(app)/leaderboard/LeaderboardClient.tsx. Odds helpers computePayout/decimalOdds/formatOdds live in lib/parlays/computations.ts. The in-chat shared-prediction card is BetslipCardView inside components/room/MessageRow.tsx; the room loading skeleton is components/room/skeletons.tsx (server-safe, no 'use client', deterministic widths, shared PULSE constant).
